title: Best-Ever Scrambled Eggs
intro: This recipe can be doubled/tripled easily and is such a good idea when you have friends over for breakfast!
method: Without turning the gas on, in a pan, add in butter + eggs + milk + 1 cheese slice and stir together
Turn on the gas on the slowest setting and keep stirring
The key to these turning out gooey and yumm is keeping the gas on slow and not turning up the heat as low and slow is the way to go for this recipe
When you feel the eggs are almost ready, take it off the heat since it will cook with latent heat while you get the bread etc ready
Add in the salt and pepper and enjoy :)
caption:
BEST ever Scrambled Eggs 
lazy girl breakfast | 15 minute recipe 

this recipe can be doubled/tripled easily and is such a good idea when you have friends over for breakfast! 

Nutrition: 
C: 2 | F: 22 | P: 21
Calories: 296 per serve ( without toast )
Serves 1

Ingredientss
5 grams butter 
3 eggs
1 tbsp milk
1 cheese slice 
salt + pepper to taste

Method
without turning the gas on, in a pan, add in butter + eggs + milk + 1 cheese slice and stir together 
turn on the gas on the slowest setting and keep stirring 
the key to these turning out gooey and yumm is keeping the gas on slow and not turning up the heat as low and slow is the way to go for this recipe
when you feel the eggs are almost ready, take it off the heat since it will cook with latent heat while you get the bread etc ready 
add in the salt and pepper and enjoy :)
